subject: Recap and validation plan: Nimbus bake-off — tests, gaps, and next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Recap and validation plan: Nimbus bake-off — tests, gaps, and next steps

Sara — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap while it's fresh and the concrete validation plan we discussed so we can align timelines.

High-level pain points you confirmed:
- Inference cost volatility across peak hours (current avg appears to spike ~3x during evenings).
- 95th+ latency variability causing UI timeouts for clinical workflows.
- Need for multi-region failover and deterministic cold-start behavior for scheduled batch processing.

Primary goals you outlined:
1) Reduce unit inference cost by ~35–45% on typical workloads (chat + ranked responses).
2) Achieve 95th percentile response latency <= 150ms for interactive queries in primary region.
3) Private network option (VPC) and SOC 2 evidence for procurement.

Competitive context (vendors in your bake-off): OrbeAI, CloudLattice (you also mentioned an internal eval of a self-hosted baseline). Decision criteria we heard you emphasize: cost/unit, 95/99 latency tail, model variant parity (LLM family + instruction tuning), security posture (SOC 2/VPC/KMS), integration effort (SDKs, streaming), and support SLAs.

Open questions we captured from the group:
- OrbeAI/CloudLattice: what quantization profiles were tested and at what accuracy tradeoffs?
- On-prem/VPC: required certs and KMS integrations for Nimbus’ compliance team.
- Billing: do you need committed monthly caps vs pure usage for the Dedicated option?
- Autoscaling test: how should we emulate your evening spike pattern (session lengths + qps)?

Proposed validation/tests (owners & due dates):
- Share editable bake-off scorecard (attached) for your team to weight criteria — owner: jonas_weber — by 2026-08-07.
- Run two head-to-head latency/cost tests with your production-ish trace: Redwood vs CloudLattice vs OrbeAI — owner: grace_oconnor — test window proposed 2026-08-12 to 2026-08-13.
- Provide SOC 2 summary + redacted report and VPC design notes — owner: aditya_rao — by 2026-08-10.
- Plan live demo focused on failover + cold-start behavior (30 minutes) — schedule tentative 2026-08-11.

Attachments included: bakeoff-scorecard-template.xlsx (editable), redwood-demo-recording-20260805.mp4 (call recording), headtohead-test-plan.pdf (test parameters).

Next steps I need from Nimbus:
1) Confirm the test trace (S3 link or sanitized sample) and who on your side will own granting access.
2) Confirm weighting for decision criteria in the attached scorecard (or tell us if you want Redwood to propose a starting weighting).
3) Identify procurement contact for a SOC2/data processing addendum review.

If that reads correctly, I'll lock the dates and get Grace and Aditya to kick off the test plan.

Thanks — Jonas

Looping in technical details and test plan adjustments we discussed internally.

Sara — to your caching question: yes, we'll run both modes. Test matrix we propose (full doc attached to this thread):
- Baseline: no KV cache, quantized fp16 model, single region (us-west-2), steady-state QPS = 30, spike to 120 over 5 mins.
- Cache-enabled: prefix/KV caching enabled with typical TTL 30s and same spike pattern.
- Multi-region failover: simulate primary region outage and measure failover tail.
- Quantization sweep: 8-bit, 4-bit (where supported) with accuracy checks on your eval set.

Requirements from Nimbus:
1) Signed test NDA (we can use your standard form; if you prefer ours we can share).
2) S3 sanitized trace (Sara to share) and a short document describing endpoint auth for test harnesses.

Deliverables and owners:
- Test harness results + per-vendor perf/cost sheet — owner: grace_oconnor — deliver by 2026-08-14.
- Raw latency histograms and tail analysis — owner: grace_oconnor — deliver by 2026-08-14.
- Updated scorecard with Redwood's recommended weighting — owner: aditya_rao — deliver by 2026-08-07.

I'll also schedule a 30-minute sync to review results on 2026-08-17 (tentative). Jonas — can you confirm you still want us to include OrbeAI in the head-to-head or only Redwood vs CloudLattice?

Thanks — Grace
